g.text: Columns are the plan's time steps, but execution ignores them: an action starts when every arrow into it comes from a completed action.

g.text: 15 actions (2 of them waits), 11 type-1 edges along each lane, 15 type-2 edges between lanes. Every edge was computed by scripts/adg/adg.py from the plan;
